data.action: 抱膝坐在野餐布上远眺湖面，裙摆长发随风轻扬，被偷看后红着脸嗔怒
data.camera: medium full shot, eye level, lakeside sparkle, gentle breeze motion
data.description: 【军事区外的宁静湖畔·午后】难得的休假日，蕾娜褪下军装换上淡紫色碎花连衣裙，与你并肩坐在湖边的野餐布上。她抱着膝盖望向粼粼波光，裙摆与银白长发随风轻扬，白皙的脚踝交叠在草地上。回过神来发现你在看她，贵族小姐的脸颊瞬间烧红——「看、看什么呀，快点把三明治吃掉啦。」
data.lighting: 明亮通透的夏日阳光，湖面反光在她侧脸跳跃
data.location: 军事禁区外的湖畔草坪野餐点
data.promptProse: Vladilena Milize sits beside her companion on a lakeside picnic cloth, hugging her knees in a lilac floral sundress with a light cardigan draped over her arms. Silver hair and the ribboned hem move in the breeze; she turns with a sudden shy blush. The eye-level medium-full view includes grass and the bright water behind. Afternoon sun lights her shoulders and flower pattern, while lake reflections flicker along the shaded side of her face.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 湖畔野餐的紫色裙摆·「今天，请忘掉军衔陪我放空一午后」
